sentences.text:
JODHPUR  S.B. Criminal Miscellaneous 3rd Bail Application No. 559/2024 Shivaram S/o Nenaram, Aged About 21 Years, R/o Bagol P.s Khiwanda District Pali (At Present Lodged At Sub Jail Bali District Pali Since 04-01-2022)
 ----Petitioner  Versus State Of Rajasthan, Through Pp
----Respondent For Petitioner(s) : Mr. Anil Gupta  Mr. Devendra Singh Rathore For Respondent(s) : Mr. Mukesh Trivedi, PP
Ms. Kinjal Purohit  HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE MANOJ KUMAR GARG Order 16/01/2024
The petitioner has been arrested in connection with FIR No.01/2022 of Police Station Sadri, District Pali for the offence punishable under Sections 498A, 304B IPC.
He has preferred this third bail application under Section 439 Cr.P.C.
The second bail application was dismissed on merit by this Court on 11.07.2023.
Counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner has falsely been implicated in this case and compromise has also arrived at between the parties.
The accused-petitioner is inside the jail since 04.01.2022 and the trial of the case will take sufficient long time to be concluded.
Therefore, the benefit of bail should be granted to the accused-petitioner.
[CRLMB-559/2024] Counsel for the complainant concurs the fact of compromise, however, learned Public Prosecutor has opposed the bail application.

Shivaram vs State Of Rajasthan (2024:Rj-Jd:2465) on 16 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/132116374/
1

Having regard to the totality of the facts and circumstances of the case, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, I deem it just and proper to grant bail to the accused petitioner under Section 439 Cr.P.C.

Accordingly, the third bail application filed under Sec.439 Cr.P.C. is allowed and it is directed that petitioner Shivaram S/o Nenaram shall be released on bail in connection with FIR No.01/2022 of Police Station Sadri, District Pali provided he executes a personal bond in a sum of Rs.1,00,000/-
with two sound and solvent sureties of Rs.50,000/- each to the satisfaction of learned trial court for his appearance before that court on each and every date of hearing and whenever called upon to do so till the completion of the trial.
(MANOJ KUMAR GARG),J 290-MS/-
